content.title: Welcome to the Madison County, FL Development Council
content.text: 120 Miles from Jacksonville 50 Miles from Tallahassee Open for Opportunity Seeking fertile ground for innovation and growth? Make it Madison County, Florida. In a region with deep roots in agriculture, North Florida’s cutting-edge educational and training network is at your command while lower costs combine with a pro-business climate to fast-track profitability. Leverage a location that offers strategic speed and central access to major Southeastern metros through immediate access to I-10, with the added advantages of rail-connected sites and easy proximity to I-75 and the Southeast’s top ports and airports. This is business-forward Florida. This is family-friendly Florida, in a scenic and historic community where natural beauty and recreation are abundant. Madison, Florida is open for opportunity. Target Industries Manufacturing A location near major markets with the logistics for fast and cost-effective reach makes Madison County the right place to make and distribute better products, like Stahl-Meyer frankfurters, a national favorite for nearly a century. A large labor pool, lower costs, and one of Florida’s top-performing workforce development centers also give Madison County manufacturing a leading edge. Learn More Target Industries Distribution / Logistics Deliver to major markets across the South with ease in a central location in northernmost Florida with a logistical network that includes I-10 (with I-75 just 30 minutes away), Florida Gulf and Atlantic Class III rail line connecting daily to CSX Class I service, and convenient global access at Jacksonville’s Jaxport as well as the rest of Florida’s port network. Learn More Target Industries Agricultural Innovation An area rich in natural resources, Madison County is home to ag innovators like Birdsong Peanuts, a sector leader in sustainability, and Full Circle Diary, a family operation that combines teamwork with innovative and environmentally friendly technology. Small companies are nurtured here, while companies like Trulieve, Florida’s largest medical marijuana operator, find the County’s pro-business climate a powerful advantage. Madison County is a recreational paradise, bounded by three rivers and just minutes away from the Gulf of Mexico. As home to Madison Blue Springs State Park, the County offers year-round fishing and watersports, while extensive bicycle and walking/hiking trails add to our beautiful natural playground. And this great place to play offers the high-caliber academics to launch a career, and the vibrant community assets to lead a life of deeper satisfaction.
